relations.subject: William Rainey Harper
relations.evidence: At the age of ten he enrolled in Muskingum College in his native New Concord. At the age of fourteen, he graduated from Muskingum College.

relations.subject: William Rainey Harper
relations.evidence: In 1872, Harper enrolled in Yale University to begin his postgraduate studies, and he completed his PhD there in 1875.

relations.subject: William Rainey Harper
relations.evidence: Harper quickly assumed a series of faculty positions, including ones at the Masonic College in Macon, Tennessee, Denison University and Yale University.
